snippet.title: NRG vs G2 - VCT Americas Stage 1 Playoffs - Lower Finals
snippet.description:
VCT Americas Stage 1 marks the next step in the race to Champions Shanghai, and the stakes could not be higher. Twelve teams, two groups, and only three spots on the line.

Group Alpha is fueled by one central clash. Brazil versus the Americas. LOUD, MIBR led by Aspas, and FURIA bring regional pride, while Leviatán and Cloud9 look to challenge them. G2 stands in the middle, ready to prove they still belong among the elite.Group Omega is shaped by pressure. NRG stand as the favorites, but KRÜ arrive ready to fight, and Envy reenters the spotlight with legendary names looking to prove they can still compete.

Only 3 teams will reach Masters London. Tune in to find out Americas representatives!

We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, and Verizon.

The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

snippet.title: The Cryptic Symbology of DELTARUNE  //  Ink Theory pt. 1
snippet.description:
Within Deltarune are two stories: one concerning things like "characters", "drama", and "feelings"... and another that I've spent the last six months thinking about. THAT story is one of SYMBOLS. White pens, pointed tails, stars reflected in black water. The dark corners and jagged edges of a warm and fuzzy game. This video chronicles my attempt to delve the murky symbolic underworld at Deltarune's foundations, and map a network of connections between the weirdest of the weird in Deltarune's lore.

Who knows... maybe it'll lead to something interesting? Pay no attention to the "Ink Theory" in the title. I'm sure it won't be important.

snippet.title: Minecraft Mob Hunt… But Our Size Is Random
snippet.description:
We played Mob Hunt in Minecraft, but our size kept changing at the worst possible times.

It was Al1, Walli, Esta, Tucker, and me trying to hide, hunt, and survive while constantly changing size throughout the round. One second you’re small enough to blend in perfectly, and the next you’re way too big to hide from anyone.

The game turned into a mess pretty quickly. Hiding spots stopped working, chasing people got harder, and nobody knew what size they were going to be next.
